descriptionPersonal: Your automations each start a new chat with an agent. Requires editor access.
descriptionInterval: Starts at the next full hour, then repeats every specified number of hours.
descriptionMonthday: Months without this day are skipped.
descriptionTimezone: For example Europe/Vienna. Nonexistent daylight-saving times are skipped; repeated times run only once.
descriptionOnce: Date and time in this device’s time zone.
descriptionAttachment: References require a folder mounted in the agent. Processable files must finish processing first. Deleted files are mentioned by path only.
errorInvalid: Correct the marked fields in the highlighted tabs.
errorSave: The automation could not be saved. Your entries have been preserved. Please try again.
descriptionDelete: The automation and its execution history will be deleted. Chats already started are retained.
descriptionApp: Start personal chats on a schedule or when files change.
descriptionEnabled: Once saved, this automation starts a new chat for every matching trigger.
descriptionPaused: This automation stays saved and does not start new chats.
labelTestFile: Select a file for the test run
descriptionTestFile: Choose an existing file from the configured repository within {{folder}}. The test uses saved settings and does not change the schedule.
errorRun: The test could not be started. Check the file and permissions and try again.
descriptionSearch: Search by an automation’s name or message.
descriptionOptions: Use Options to switch between cards and table, sort and group your automations, or save your preferred view.
descriptionEditorOverview: Define the trigger and chat, then name the automation under Settings. Activate or pause it here and review your current draft.
descriptionTrigger: First choose whether a schedule or a file event starts the chat.
descriptionStartChat: Choose the agent and message for the new chat.
descriptionSchedule: Choose the recurrence, then adjust the interval or date below.
descriptionFolderScope: Select the repository and folder together in the dialog. The root folder covers the entire selected repository.

descriptions.time: Starts on a schedule or at a one-time date.
descriptions.storage: Responds to files in a repository or folder.

summary.monthly: On day {{day}} of the month at {{time}} ({{timezone}})

descriptionAppearance: Choose an icon and color for the app card.
descriptionDescription: A short description for the card. Define the message under “Start chat”.
descriptionDiscard: Discard all unsaved changes to this automation?
descriptionDefineName: Set the name, description and appearance in settings.
descriptionDefineTrigger: Choose a schedule or file events and folder.
descriptionDefineChat: Choose an agent and write a message.
descriptionRecommendedMessages: Choose a suggestion from the agent, then edit the message below.
descriptionNoRuns: Runs appear here once the automation executes.
descriptionRuns: The latest 50 runs. Dates and times use your device timezone: {{timezone}}.
descriptionNextRun: Dates and times use your language and device timezone. Unsaved changes show a preview after saving.
errorName: Enter a name containing 1 to 200 characters.
errorDescription: The description must not exceed 10,000 characters.
errorAgent: Select an agent for the new chat.
errorMessage: Enter a message containing 1 to 100,000 characters.
errorFolder: Select a repository and a folder.
errorEvents: Select at least one file event.
errorInterval: Enter a whole number between 1 and 8,760 hours.
errorTimezone: Enter a valid time zone, for example Europe/Vienna.
errorOnce: Enter a valid date and time.
descriptionRunsConnecting: Connecting to live updates. The displayed data will refresh automatically once connected.
